subject: Hospitality
title: AI-Powered Pricing Engines
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: AI-Powered Pricing Engines.

hook.text: AI pricing engines now set hotel rates automatically—analyzing millions of data points no human could process.

buildup.text: Machine learning models ingest competitor rates, event data, web traffic, weather forecasts, and booking patterns simultaneously.

discovery.text: These systems learn from outcomes. If a price change increased bookings, the model adjusts. It improves itself continuously.

twist.text: Some revenue managers resist AI, fearing it replaces their judgment. In reality, the best systems augment human decisions.

climax.text: Hotels using AI pricing report 5–10% revenue lifts compared to traditional methods. The technology advantage compounds over time.

punchline.text: Millions of data points, real-time adjustments. AI prices faster than any human.

quiz.question: How much revenue lift do hotels typically see from AI pricing?
